title: BoulderTree local group fork configuration
description: JSON Schema for a local C.A. group website fork (group.json). Based on Drive folder '02 - CA Regional Website & Service' documents 'Group Fork Config - Bottom Line (Club 101)' and 'BoulderTree — GitHub Repository Architecture'. Every factual field accepts the literal placeholder '[VERIFY]'. Anonymity rules (Traditions Eleven and Twelve): no person names, personal phone numbers, or personal email addresses. The only optional contact fields are a group service email and a group service URL. additionalProperties is false throughout. Do not commit live rosters or private records. v1.1.0 (additive, backward compatible) adds optional fellowship, region, area, areaSlug, venueLocality, traditionsCompliance, worldConference2027, meetings[].durationMinutes, and links.areaHub from Drive docs 'BoulderTree — group-config.schema.json & JSON-LD Generator Spec' and 'CA Southwest Region — SEO, Geographic Routing & Local Meeting Pivot Blueprint'.

isSample.description: When true, this file is a sample or template, not a verified live group listing.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this configuration shape. 1.0.0 (original) or 1.1.0 (adds optional geographic, compliance, and conference fields).

slug.description: URL-safe identifier for the fork (no person names).

groupName.description: Public group name only. Not a person's name. Use '[VERIFY]' if unconfirmed.

venueLabel.description: Public venue or meeting-place label (for example a club or hall name), not a street address.

venueAddress.description: Public venue address if one is confirmed. Use '[VERIFY]' when unconfirmed. Do not invent an address.

cadence.description: How often meetings occur. Use '[VERIFY]' if unconfirmed.

welcomeCopy.description: Public welcome / first-meeting posture copy. No person names or personal contacts.

seventhTraditionNote.description: Short 7th Tradition / self-support note for the public page.

traditionsNote.description: Public traditions and anonymity guardrails for this fork.

meetings.description: One or more meetings. Schedule, timezone, and attendance/format facts may be '[VERIFY]'.

groupServiceEmail.description: Optional group or area service mailbox only. Not an individual's personal email. Use '[VERIFY]' if a mailbox exists but is unconfirmed.

groupServiceUrl.description: Optional group service page or form URL (http or https only). Use '[VERIFY]' if unconfirmed.

fellowship.description: Fellowship name used in JSON-LD (for example 'Cocaine Anonymous'). Optional; the generator defaults to 'Cocaine Anonymous'.

region.description: Regional service boundary (for example 'Southwest Region'). Used for areaServed / parentOrganization JSON-LD and hub routing.

area.description: Area or metro hub name (for example 'Austin / Central Texas'). Used for hub-and-spoke routing and areaServed.

areaSlug.description: URL-safe area hub slug (for example 'austin-central-texas'), or '[VERIFY]'.

publicSafeString.description: Public, anonymity-safe text. The literal '[VERIFY]' is allowed when a fact is unconfirmed. Must not contain a personal email address or a phone number.

anyOf.description: An http(s) URL only. tel:, sms:, and mailto: are not allowed.
A group service email only (for example a group or area service mailbox). Not an individual's personal email.
A clock time such as '7:30 p.m.' or '19:30'.
An IANA timezone name such as America/Chicago, or UTC.

format.description: Open or closed meeting format, or '[VERIFY]'.

attendance.description: In-person, online, or hybrid attendance, or '[VERIFY]'.

links.description: Optional public http(s) links, or '[VERIFY]'. No personal mailto, tel, or sms URLs. Online meeting URLs (for example a Zoom join link) belong in onlineMeetingUrl and stay '[VERIFY]' until confirmed.

enabled.description: Whether this section is shown, or '[VERIFY]'.

sections.description: Optional page sections from the group-fork and regional architecture documents.

regionalHotline.description: Pointer to a regional help page only. Do not put a phone number in title, summary, or url.

venueLocality.description: Public city/state/country of the venue (no street address here). Each value may be '[VERIFY]'.

traditionsCompliance.description: Explicit Traditions Six, Seven, Eleven, and Twelve guardrail acknowledgements. When present, every flag must be true.

worldConference2027.description: August 2027 World Conference room-block card facts. Booking URL lives in links.worldConferenceBooking. Unconfirmed values stay '[VERIFY]'.
